description: Guarded safety and annotation primitives. These are not diagnostic logic.

concepts.description: Redact obvious PHI-like spans for safety demonstrations.
Mark the workflow requirement that negated clinical statements must be preserved.
Annotate uncertainty cues without making diagnosis claims.

implementations.python: lambda s: {'text': s, 'uncertainty_required': any(term in s.lower() for term in ['possible', 'may', 'could', 'unclear'])}

concepts.description: Flag safety-sensitive text for human review without diagnosing.

implementations.python: lambda s: {'requires_review': True, 'reason': 'clinical red flag workflow requires human review'}
implementations.javascript: (s) => ({ requires_review: true, reason: 'clinical red flag workflow requires human review' })

concepts.description: Require human escalation for sensitive workflows.
